item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia has launched ballistic missiles at Zelenskyy's hometown and conducted airspace violations over Poland, while a drone strike set a Russian cargo ship ablaze in the Gulf of Finland and another drone attack hit a vessel in the Baltic Sea. Ukraine responded with strikes on the Kerch Bridge and reported a massive explosion on a Lviv street, and a Swedish Gripen pilot failed to intercept a suspected Russian missile over Poland due to poor weather. Russian sabotage attacks prompted Estonia to close its border with Russia, and explosions were reported near the Russian Baltic Fleet base in Kaliningrad Oblast. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

In the West Bank, Israeli settlers shot a 72‑year-old Palestinian woman near a new outpost and the IDF demolished a Palestinian home in violation of a Supreme Court order, while Israel delayed settlement building contracts after UK sanctions. Israeli strikes on vehicles distributing food aid in Gaza have repeatedly killed three people, with the IDF saying the targets were terror operatives masquerading as aid workers. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: South Sudan: the situation
item.description:
